svg.title: Samet Temizer — Technical universe
svg.desc: Thirty-five engineering skills form five luminous constellations around an animated cyan and violet orbital core. AI and retrieval, data and integration, backend architecture, infrastructure and delivery, quality and observability. All skill labels stay readable while orbital light trails rotate. Open with #static or enable reduced motion for a still illustration.
